summary: The approved Explore converges Change 5 into one final DeliveryOperationPackage variant plus a bounded repository-integration host: exact Delivery Final continuity, exact pre-integration Git facts and singleton Owner Git authority produce exactly one final commit; ordinary provider-external review/merge mechanics follow; accepted main is then independently re-read from Git and becomes next-base continuity. Proposal explicitly separates targetMainPreIntegrationCommit from terminal acceptedMainCommit and omits Git provider/PR database, Promotion lifecycle, automatic rebase/correction, new candidate identity, release/next-Delivery automation, D05 and mandatory transport.
